title: spartocytisus albus
intro: Spartocytisus albus, commonly known as White Spindle or Spiny Broom, is a flowering plant in the pea family. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, with reported health benefits including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial effects. The therapeutic actions of Spartocytisus albus include soothing skin irritations, reducing fever, and supporting the immune system. The bioactive constituents present in this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
